headline.en: Tea-infused coffee in a garden setting

traits.zh: 使用碧螺春、西湖龙井等茶咖豆
traits.en: Uses tea-based coffee beans like Biluochun and Longjing

traits.zh: 提供含苹果片、肉桂棒的热饮
traits.en: Serves spiced hot drinks with apple slices and cinnamon sticks

traits.zh: 设有绿植造景与户外露营区的超千平大店
traits.en: Features greenery and outdoor camping area in a 1000+ sqm space

traits.zh: 配备圆形木桌与椅子，提供固定座位
traits.en: Offers fixed wooden tables and chairs for seating

energy.zh: 庭院与露营区带来自然氛围
energy.en: Garden and camping area create ambient energy

adventure.zh: 茶咖与香料饮品具实验性
adventure.en: Tea-coffee and spiced drinks are experimental
